visualCharacteristics.purpose: top-of-page split hero with copy on one half and a hexagon-cropped photo on the other
visualCharacteristics.layout: two panes side by side on desktop (text left, photo right), stacked on mobile
visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Solid sky-blue (#63b6ff) full-width band supplied by section style; photo cropped into a hexagon; dark pill CTA

contentPattern.structure: row 1: image (photo, alt text); row 2: text (H1 title, intro paragraph, CTA link)
contentPattern.reason: Top-of-page H1 with prominent image and CTA, side-by-side split layout
contentPattern.variantReason: Solid-color band with text half left and hexagon-cropped photo half right (not a full-bleed background photo)

usage: Use as the first block on a page when the hero has a solid color band, H1, short intro, one CTA and a shaped photo beside the copy.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any split hero with a single image beside the copy. Use the base hero for full-bleed background-image heroes.
